groupings.title: Core Guards
groupings.description: Reactive guardrails for code, tests, and documentation after an agent has produced work. Apply these after any agent writes, edits, or generates code or documentation files in this project.

groupings.title: WordPress & WooCommerce Guards
groupings.description: Reactive shipping checks for WordPress and WooCommerce code. Use woo-guard for WooCommerce order/product/checkout logic; wp-guard for all other WordPress plugin and theme code.
